confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three searches of aggregated or crowdsourced cost-of-living data and travel guides. Those sources disagree and vary in date, so restaurant and drink figures are bounded estimates. Wine and cocktail are set relative to local beer prices because direct figures were weak, and alcohol is sold only in licensed venues. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context. No accommodation searches were run, and no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Anchors are for a July 2026 window; MAD-to-USD conversion is approximate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: a mid-sized North African port city with a mixed budget and mid-range hotel market, priced below southern European capitals and above rural Moroccan towns. Food anchors use aggregated Casablanca cost-of-living figures (about MAD 45-51 for an inexpensive meal, about MAD 300 for a three-course dinner for two, about MAD 22 for a cappuccino). Drink anchors use Moroccan restaurant beer, wine and cocktail ranges, with wine and cocktails set relative to beer. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic estimates.
